text:
maria: Heads-up from ACME: they want a "spare-burst" mode so short spikes don't hit quota hard. Can we scope pilot?

dan: Define "short" plz. Seconds? Also need failure-mode: graceful demotion vs reject.

krish: Proposal: spare-burst = allow requests under 512 tokens for an extra 10s beyond quota. Demotion path: quantized-same-model -> smaller-model -> reject. Runtime handles demotion locally to avoid cross-pool pressure.

krish: Sample config:
```
tenant:
  spare_burst:
    enabled: true
    token_limit: 512
    window_s: 10
    demote_order: ["rwd-3b-quant","rwd-1b","reject"]
```

olivia: Launch criteria: ACME pilot + perf test (p95 demoted latency < 400ms), billing attribution for demotions, and customer docs.

billing-bot: billing event required: demotion_event(tenant, orig_model, demoted_model, tokens).

dan: Ops: ensure demotion scoped inside tenant pool; add circuit to disable demotion if demotion_rate > 1% and region latency rises.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: feature branch `spare_burst_v1` created; canary dry-run scheduled.

maria: Owners: krish RFC, dan ops runbook, olivia launch checklist, billing to attach event. Meeting Thursday 9am to finalize.

krish: I'll draft RFC tonight and include memory/prewarm numbers.

maria: Thanks everyone.
